name: Promexa – Advanced Promo Box Widget for Elementor
author: Kartik chavda

sections.description:
Promexa – Advanced Promo Box Widget for Elementor helps you create modern promotional layouts with flexible content controls, hover animations, badge systems, image effects, and responsive styling options.

Promexa also includes a built-in documentation panel directly inside the WordPress admin area, allowing users to quickly learn widget controls, styling options, animations, and advanced features without leaving the dashboard.

Build visually attractive Elementor sections for:

  • Product promotions
  • Service highlights
  • Marketing cards
  • Call-to-action sections
  • Affiliate promotions
  • Announcement banners
  • Landing page content
  • Feature showcase layouts

Designed with performance and flexibility in mind, Promexa provides advanced customization options while keeping layouts lightweight and responsive.

Why Choose Promexa?

Promexa provides premium promotional layouts with advanced hover interactions, modern animation systems, flexible badge styles, and responsive Elementor controls designed for professional websites.

Unlike basic promo widgets, Promexa includes:

  • Advanced hover border effects
  • Multiple badge systems
  • Custom image animations
  • Flexible CTA behavior
  • Modern responsive layouts
  • Premium UI styling controls

Features

Layout Features

  • Classic & Cover image layouts
  • Flexible image positioning
  • Responsive content alignment
  • Full box clickable layouts
  • Modern promotional card designs

Image Controls

  • Background image support
  • Image overlay effects
  • Custom image sizing
  • Minimum width controls
  • Responsive image height settings
  • Blend mode support

Badge System

  • Corner badges
  • Circle badges
  • Flag badges
  • Badge typography controls
  • Badge size & positioning controls

Hover & Animation Effects

  • Advanced hover border animations
  • Multiple hover interaction styles
  • Image zoom animations
  • Image movement effects
  • Transition timing controls
  • Custom Promexa animation library

Content Controls

  • Icon or image support
  • Flexible title HTML tags
  • WYSIWYG description editor
  • Advanced CTA button settings
  • Custom link behavior options

Styling Controls

  • Background & hover backgrounds
  • Typography customization
  • Border radius controls
  • Box shadow effects
  • Padding & spacing controls
  • Responsive editing support

Performance

  • Lightweight structure
  • Optimized rendering
  • Minified assets

  • Responsive layouts

  • Built-in professional documentation panel inside WordPress admin

  • User-friendly documentation with detailed control explanations
  • Organized documentation sections for content, styling, animations, and effects
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor.
  4. Search for “Promexa Promo Box”.
  5. Drag and drop the widget into your layout.
  6. Start customizing your promo sections.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes, Promexa works with Elementor Free.

Is it compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with Elementor Pro.

Is the widget responsive?

Yes. All layouts and controls support responsive editing for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I make the entire promo box clickable?

Yes. The widget supports full box clickable layouts.

Does it support hover animations?

Yes. Promexa includes advanced hover border effects, image animations, and interactive transitions.

Can I use custom icons or images?

Yes. You can use Elementor icons or custom images.

Does the plugin include documentation?

Yes. Promexa includes a built-in documentation page inside the WordPress admin dashboard with detailed explanations for widget controls, styling options, animations, hover effects, and layout settings.
